description: sandbox_executor needs a CI AST ratchet capping broad except Exception catches per module/package so unratcheted broad catches cannot accumulate.
goal: Add a fast AST-based broad except Exception ratchet test in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_broad_except_ratchet.py that scans apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/, locks the current per-module and per-package except Exception catch baseline, fails CI when unratcheted broad except Exception catches are added above baseline, and passes cleanly when counts are equal to or lower than baseline so follow-up narrowing changes can tighten the cap. Include unit tests verifying both regressions fail and reductions pass. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: Locking current except Exception counts in CI stops broad-catch growth immediately while keeping this change isolated from module-narrowing edits.
acceptance_criteria: CI fails when unratcheted except Exception catches are added (ratchet-only cap per module/package passes when equal or lower).
apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_broad_except_ratchet.py passes uv run pytest apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_broad_except_ratchet.py and uv run task lint.
